name: Bulk photo library and file system
plain: A site cannot browse your photo library or disk by itself.
meaning: Only files the person picks (or a folder they grant) are visible. No silent photo, music or Downloads scan.

access.prompt_ui: File chooser or folder grant required each time
access.iframe: Same as top level; cross-origin iframes need a permissions policy where listed

data.metric: A site cannot browse your photo library or disk by itself.

limits.headline: Can't browse your whole photo library or your files on its own
limits.user_action: You tap Upload and pick files or a folder yourself each time.
can: Open the files you pick in a file chooser
Open a folder you pick, in browsers that allow it
Remember a folder you pick for later in some browsers, if you grant it again
cannot: See your photo library or your files without you picking them
Browse folders or look at file names you did not choose
Keep access after you close the page in most cases
Pick files on your behalf without the file chooser
limits.reach_label: Only what you pick, each time

story.what_it_is: A site cannot browse your photos or files by itself.
story.for_you: You choose which photo or file to upload. The site sees only what you pick, nothing else on your device.
story.for_makers: Apps wanted to scan whole photo libraries to find faces or sort things and to build profiles. Instead they use a file picker that shows one thing at a time, or ask for one folder.

use_cases.example: A photo app wants to scan all your pictures for faces. Instead you pick one image to post.
A resale site wants to see your gallery. Instead you pick up to ten photos of an item.
A cloud drive wants your whole folder. It asks you to choose one folder to sync.
An editor wants your whole library, but you open each project file by hand.
Malware wants to scan your documents. The browser will not let a page read files you did not pick.
A school portal asks a child to pick one picture, never the whole camera roll.

technical_bounds: No enumeration of photos, contacts, messages or system folders
Folder grants exclude system folders such as Downloads root and home
iOS gives only the picker's selected photos

abuse: Social engineering to pick sensitive files
